description: This file defines an interface for node visitor classes in Twig, enabling custom operations during the traversal of a template's abstract syntax tree.

classes.name: Twig\NodeVisitor\NodeVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for node visitor classes in Twig, specifying methods for visiting and leaving nodes during traversal, and retrieving visitor priority.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Method called before child nodes are visited, returns a possibly modified node.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Method called after child nodes are visited, returns a modified node or null to remove the node.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the visitor, used to determine the order of node visitation.
